groups.recovery: The scan run has durable queued/running/complete/failed/abandoned state, attempt count, keyset cursor and lease-token fencing; retry/restart cases pass, including exact maxAttempts bounds. Restore is not specifically qualified for this cache: an operator must keep the derived feature unavailable or trigger a fresh scan until restore source freshness is known; do not claim the cache is automatically cleared or that a backup restore reconstructs all current pointers. groups.backfillDisposition: No backfill is introduced: the scan run/pointer tables are new and start empty; the two optional company contact references are nullable and are not inferred/backfilled from historic users or support data.
groups.retirementDisposition: No deprecation/sunset/removal/retirement of the scanner or stored contact values is qualified. Pointer expiry governs read eligibility; cleanup/retention lifecycle and operator observation remain explicit future owner decisions.
groups.irreversibleBoundaries: No destructive schema contraction is in 0565. Contact changes remain reversible through owner-authorized settings; scan cache is derived but has no verified restore-reset owner. Do not drop tables or erase contact identities without a separately reviewed consumer/retention phase.

Added nullable optional security/support incident contact references on companies; settings route restricts selection to active verified same-company Humans, and labels alone confer no authority.
